name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Suncatcher with Display Stand
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, stainless steel, and wood, offering a bright, elegant, and durable decorative finish.
    - Features 1-layer acrylic suncatcher pieces that create a colorful and eye-catching stained-glass-inspired display effect.
    - Each acrylic piece has a thickness of 3mm, providing a lightweight yet sturdy structure for long-term use.
    - Comes with a stainless steel hanger for a graceful hanging presentation and a wooden stand for a stable tabletop display.
    - The wooden stand has a thickness of ~1.5 cm (~0.59 in), giving the finished product a solid and balanced base.
    - Includes metal circular rings to connect the suncatcher pieces, with the quantity depending on the selected design.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Finished product height: 20 cm ~ 7.87 in
    - Wooden stand diameter/width: 9 cm ~ 3.54 in
    - Wooden stand thickness: 1.5 cm ~ 0.59 in
    - Suncatcher 1 size: 2.5 x 2.5 in ~ 6.36 x 6.36 cm
    - Suncatcher 2 size: 2.5 x 2.5 in ~ 6.36 x 6.36 cm
    📌 Note:  The dimensions of the acrylic suncatcher may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Features single-sided printing on the acrylic suncatcher and wooden stand.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative suncatcher and a personalized tabletop display piece.
    - Designed to hang elegantly from the stainless steel hanger while standing securely on the wooden base.
    - Suitable for desks, shelves, countertops, windowsides, and decorative display corners.
    - The acrylic pieces help reflect and brighten surrounding light, creating a colorful and charming visual effect.
    - Perfect for home décor, sentimental keepsakes, and personalized gift displays.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, memorial occasions, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for grandparents, parents, sea-life lovers, and anyone who enjoys personalized decorative keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving names, heartfelt messages, and meaningful memories in a unique display format.
    - Great for desk décor, shelf decoration, and commemorative gift giving.
    - Adds a bright, artistic, and heartfelt touch to any personal space🎁
     

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Suncatcher with Display Stand

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
